asks.name: kept-gateway
asks.message: There is a gateway here called acct-edge-igw, marked PLT-5310, that I did not put there. Should this network's way out leave through that one instead of one I stand up myself?

asks.name: default-path
asks.message: The table everything here rides by default came back marked checkout-web under SIB-6605 and already sends 0.0.0.0/0 somewhere. Is that path mine to re-aim or remove while I add my own?

asks.name: chargeback-mark
asks.message: Everything I read back in this network carries FIN-8821 alongside its cost centre. Does the table I am standing up have to carry the same?

asks.name: control-mark
asks.message: The network itself and the gateway it leaves through both came back carrying NSE-4471. Does what I add have to say the same thing about itself?

asks.name: paraphrase
asks.message: While I was working, a gateway I did not create got attached to this network and a route to everywhere appeared on the table it rides by default. Whose conventions govern that?

asks.name: generic
asks.message: Any conventions I should follow here?
